name: Nautilink
tagline: Verifies fishing supply chains with vessel tracking and blockchain records to fight illegal fishing.

awards: Best Use of Solana by MLH

problem: Fishing regulations are unverifiable, enabling illegal fishing and bycatch; the team cites research figures.
solution: Combines vessel tracking data, geospatial analysis and on-chain records to verify where fish were caught.
demo_moment: Team-described: trace a catch from vessel to buyer.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Use of Solana by MLH” among 195 submissions.
Cites sources for every statistic in its pitch.

lessons: A sixty-second pitch with sourced numbers earns trust fast.
